BL-1295 — A revert commit inherits its reverted ticket's subject, so the send-time scope gate blames that ticket for the revert's foreign paths and refuses the handoff
What it solves: BL-1240 is blocked on this ticket. It is complete at the documenter, docs
verified unchanged and correct, and it is holding in_process rather than
being bounced or worked around - the documenter was right not to force it.
Approval context: Sign-off on the new feature file, and one judgement worth confirming.
I refused the two available workarounds rather than using them. BL-1240 could be unblocked today by declaring BL-973's how-to in its `retires:` list, which the gate would accept - but `retires:` means the ticket is chartered to r…
